name: Derived-state staging correctness (auto-commit + ignore filtering)
goal: Fix auto-commit staging so lifecycle transitions always commit durable state and never fail on gitignored paths: call git check-ignore with --no-index so tracked-but-ignored paths are filtered correctly, stage only existing/changed durable artifacts instead of walking all of .synth/data, fall back to per-file adds so one bad path cannot kill the commit, and surface the autoCommit result (committed/commitHash/files/reason) in command JSON. Absorbs draft e8ba8f92 and the index-surgery half of the Reads-Never-Write plan (W2).
